key_facts: Employees may carry forward a maximum of 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year.

cases.question: What are the core working hours for shore staff, and how many compensatory days can be earned for weekend travel?
key_facts: Standard shore office hours are 09:00 to 17:30 Monday through Friday with mandatory core collaboration hours from 10:00 to 15:30.

cases.question: What are the eligibility criteria for hybrid remote work, including home office equipment stipend?
key_facts: Permanent shore employees who have passed the 90-day probation period may work remotely up to 2 days per week with line manager approval.
Eligible hybrid shore staff may claim a one-time home-office ergonomic equipment stipend of up to USD 450 once every 24 months (chair, external monitor, desk lamp, or headset).

cases.question: What are the meal, lodging, and mileage reimbursement limits for business travel?

cases.question: What are the conditions for submitting expense claims, including non-reimbursable items?
key_facts: All expense claims with itemized receipts must be submitted within 14 calendar days after trip completion.
